_comment: Copy this to aso.config.json in your app project root to set defaults so the skill stops re-asking. All fields are optional.
_font: Bundled headline font key: inter | montserrat | poppins | oswald | bebas | archivo | playfair. The skill auto-picks one if omitted.
_targetSizes: App Store Connect display sizes to export. 1242x2688 (6.5"), 1290x2796 (6.7", default), 1320x2868 (6.9").
_languages: Locales to generate headline sets for. More than one triggers localized output under screenshots/final/<lang>/.
_showcaseHandle: Footer text on the showcase image. Leave empty to omit.
